entities.name: Ladislav Olejník
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ladislav Olejník was a Czech ice hockey player who also coached in Germany. He played for ZSJ GZ Královo Pole and Rudá hvězda Brno from 1950 to 1967 and was a coach in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga from 1968 to 2005.
